# Scanning Checklist: WARP Registration & Endpoint Scan

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of endpoint candidate provisioning, verification, ranking, and caching requirements
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK026 Are built-in candidate requirements specified per transport AND per address family (WARP v4/v6, MASQUE v4/v6)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK027 Are port-pool requirements specified for both transports (which ports, in what order)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK028 Are default-scan-choice requirements specified (which profile ships as default)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK029 Are cache-winner re-verification requirements defined (what "re-verify first" executes)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK030 Are cache-eviction requirements defined (when a winner is dropped)? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK031 Is "actual traffic" in verification defined (what traffic proves a candidate)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the ranking rule total — how are equal-latency candidates ordered? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK033 Is "measured round-trip time" defined (handshake time, traffic time, or combined)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK034 Is "still works" for skipping a full scan quantified (latency bound, failure count)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK035 Is the default scan profile named in the spec consistent with contracts/profiles.md (`balanced`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK036 Are the shipped-candidates rule (FR-006) and the replaceable-data rule (FR-014) consistent about what ships vs what the operator overrides? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK037 Does US-002 scenario 2 (zero-config connect) agree with FR-008 (cache-first) on first-run behavior with an empty cache? [Consistency, Spec §US-002, §FR-008]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK038 Can SC-002 (at least one traffic-verified endpoint with latency) be objectively measured on an unblocked network? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK039 Can SC-003 (connects with no hand-supplied endpoint or keys) be objectively verified end-to-end? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK040 Can SC-007 (zero-config fresh-install connection) be objectively verified from a clean profile? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK041 Are requirements defined for scans that find candidates but all fail traffic verification (vs finding none)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK042 Are requirements defined for scanning while a session is up without disturbing it (isolation mechanism)? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK043 Are requirements defined for per-family candidate exhaustion (v6 candidates all fail, v4 works)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK044 Are requirements defined for a scan whose cache winner fails re-verification mid-scan? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK045 Are requirements defined for malformed operator-supplied candidate data (shape errors beyond fail-closed)? [Coverage, contracts/profiles.md]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK046 Are scan time/size bounds specified so candidate space cannot grow unboundedly? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK047 Are dual-stack reporting requirements specified for scan results (which family won and why)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK048 Is the assumption that shipped ranges stay usable validated (staleness detection or refresh policy)? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK049 Is the "no silent unverified fallback" rule consistent between empty scans and all-failed scans? [Consistency, Spec §US-002]

## Re-sweep (post-analyze, 2026-09-16)

- [ ] CHK100 Are confidence requirements defined for the scan fast path — does a re-verified winner keep its traffic-verified verdict, and is the reasoning stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK101 Are scan-during-live-session requirements defined (isolation mechanism and non-disturbance criteria)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK102 Are per-transport winner requirements specified (separate winners per transport, eviction, re-verify-first) or only a single last-known-good? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK103 Are transport-to-candidate-section mapping requirements specified (which transports draw from which warp.toml sections, and what unknown transports receive)? [Completeness, contracts/profiles.md]
- [ ] CHK104 Are scan-outcome reporting requirements consistent between the US-002 acceptance scenarios and the CLI contract (ranked shape, latency figures, empty behavior)? [Consistency, Spec §US-002]
- [ ] CHK105 Are IPv6-range sampling requirements specified, given that full-range enumeration is infeasible and seeds must carry discovery? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK106 Are missing-or-malformed warp.toml fallback requirements specified (which default applies, and does scanning stay gated on validity)? [Coverage, contracts/profiles.md]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
